title: Adopt the studio workflows in an existing game
description: A reversible, evidence-producing workflow for adopt the studio workflows in an existing game.

ordered_stages.action: Read project structure, conventions, generated files, tools, and repository state.
Map requested workflows to existing capabilities without replacing working tools.
Show one scoped setup, exact generated files, conflicts, permissions, and rollback.
Wait for explicit confirmation of the transaction digest.
Apply approved additions and prove that build, tests, and rollback still work.

quality_gates.description: Verify rights, consent, code, weights, datasets, output terms, and generation provenance.
Validate formats and domain-specific technical constraints.
Check visual identity and temporal consistency across relevant views and frames.
Check memory, frame time, draw calls, load time, and asset budgets.
Run interaction and playability smoke tests in the target runtime.
Store screenshots, artifacts, logs, versions, and comparison evidence.
Require human approval before replacing any source or production asset.
Existing project conventions and unrelated changes remain intact.
New automation can be disabled and rolled back without damaging project state.

fallbacks: Use the core skills without editor automation.
Adopt one workflow at a time when conflicts cannot be resolved safely.
